evidence.title: GitHub - pranshuparmar/witr: Why is this running? Trace any process, port, container, or file back to what started it - CLI + TUI. · GitHub

name: witr
summary: CLI and TUI that traces a process, port, container or file back to what started it.
description: Answers "why is this running?" for any process, port, container or file: one command prints the chain that started it, the output also comes as machine-readable JSON, or you can explore interactively in a TUI. A browser sandbox with a guided tutorial and free-play mode ships alongside the CLI.
contains: traces a process, port, container or file back to the exact chain that started it
one command, machine-readable JSON output, or an interactive TUI
browser sandbox: guided tutorial and free-play on a simulated Linux box
install via package managers (incl. mamba, pixi) or run without installation
topics: linux, macos, freebsd, docker, kubernetes, observability, incident response
